title: The Entrance To The Clerics' Guild
description: The entrance hall is a small modest room, reflecting the true nature of the Clerics.  The exit leads east to the temple square.  A small entrance to the bar is in the northern wall. [ Exits: n e ] An automatic teller machine has been installed in the wall here. A janitor is walking around, cleaning up. An oozing green gelatinous blob is here, sucking in bits of debris. A knight templar is guarding the entrance. 34H 100M 87V (news) (motd) >
